<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/b/pbl/v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/cycles/"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the billing-cycle history of a subscription, including the payment attempts of each cycle.

Each billing cycle is one Ottu transaction with order number `<subscription ID>-c<cycle number>` (for example `sub_…-c2`). Every retry attempt belongs to that one transaction. The first payment is your own checkout transaction, so its `session_id` is the one you created.

`limit` and `offset` belong in the query string, and `next` and `previous` can be followed directly with `GET`. A cycle with `status: "needs_triage"` means you should contact Ottu support.


<pre style={{display:"none"}}>{"curl --location --globoff 'https://sandbox.ottu.net/b/pbl/v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/cycles/?limit={limit}&offset={offset}' \\\n--header 'Accept: application/json' \\\n--header 'Authorization: Api-Key YOUR_API_KEY'"}</pre>
